candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to owner with assignment to tx.origin so setOwner sets owner = tx.origin instead of the provided _owner.
Remove the owner assignment so setOwner no longer changes owner but still returns true.
Assign owner to msg.sender instead of the provided _owner so owner becomes the caller.
Change onlyOwner require to compare msg.sender to tx.origin, altering who is allowed to call setOwner.
Invert the onlyOwner check so only non-owners can call functions with this modifier.
Remove the require entirely so onlyOwner imposes no restriction and setOwner can be called by anyone.

Change the function to assign owner only after returning true, so return value is still true but state change happens after — but because return executes immediately, state assignment is unreachable; here we move assignment after return which makes function return true but owner unchanged (different observable behavior: return value same? Wait requirement: return value differs — adjust).
Make the function return false instead of true while still assigning owner — changes observable return value for successful calls.

Change onlyOwner modifier to require caller is NOT owner, inverting the guard so setOwner can be called by non-owner and thus the call that previously succeeded may now revert or differ; affects which calls complete — but for calls that complete in both, return differs only via U001 mutants; include variant that causes setOwner to be callable by everyone, altering which invocations are valid.
Replace the assignment to owner so setOwner writes msg.sender instead of the provided _owner, changing resulting owner after call.
Remove the assignment to owner so setOwner no longer updates state, leaving owner unchanged after call.
Make setOwner set owner to the zero address, so observable owner becomes address(0) after call.
Change the onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender is not the owner, inverting the access check so setOwner can be called only by non-owners, affecting whether owner is updated.
